:::{#def-iterative-method}
#### Iterative method, iterates and error

An **iterative method** starts from a point $\vx^{(0)}$
and computes $\vx^{(t+1)}$ from $\vx^{(t)}$ by a fixed rule, for $t = 0, 1, 2, \ldots$;
the points $\vx^{(t)}$ are its **iterates**.
For a point $\vx^*$ that the method is meant to reach,
$\norm{\vx^{(t)} - \vx^*}$ is the **error** of the iterate $\vx^{(t)}$.

:::
